title: Country Climate and Development Report: Seychelles
temporal_coverage: Climate risks, sector analyses and modeled development pathways through 2050; selected sea-level results to 2100.
methodology: World Bank assessment combines climate-risk, sector and economy-wide modelling.
limitations: Scenario and survey-based estimates, not observed outcomes.

title: Seychelles’ Third National Communication under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
organization: Republic of Seychelles, Ministry of Agriculture, Climate Change and Environment
temporal_coverage: National climate communication; observed and projected sectoral risks, with precipitation simulations through 2100.
methodology: Government communication compiled with ministries, local bodies and other contributors.

title: UNDP Supports Stronger Early Warning Systems and Disaster Preparedness in Seychelles
temporal_coverage: TIAEWS project inputs and planned disaster-information and early-warning functions reported in July 2026.
methodology: Official UNDP announcement reports a project handover and stated objectives.
limitations: Press release describes an input and planned functions, not evaluated results.

title: About Us
organization: Department of Risk and Disaster Management, Government of Seychelles
temporal_coverage: Institutional history through the December 2025 transformation of DRMD into DRDM.
methodology: Departmental page summarizes its statutory basis, institutional history and mandate.
limitations: Institutional self-description does not evaluate operational effectiveness.

title: UNDP Seychelles Country Programme Document 2024–2028
temporal_coverage: UNDP country programme theory of change for 2024–2028.
methodology: Official publication page provides the programme’s theory-of-change extract.
limitations: The extract records programme intentions, not implementation or results.
